title: kb-setup says install-python.ps1 can install only uv
goal: kb-setup step 1 says install-python.ps1 always installs the pinned Python as well as uv, and that a Windows host with another Python that lacks only uv installs the pinned uv release by hand as python/uv-windows-install shows.
notes: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-fep4fpsx “Windows ready” (ST-xqx3ffyu).
